summary: Switch with a label and hint whose thumb stretches as it travels and pops a few pixel sparks when it turns on.

props.name: children
props.description: Label text. It is also the switch's accessible name.

props.name: hint
props.description: Secondary text under the label, linked to the switch with `aria-describedby`.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: Called when the user toggles the switch. Changing `checked` from outside does not call it.

accessibility: The switch is a native `<button>` with `role="switch"` and `aria-checked`.
The label is the switch's accessible name (`aria-labelledby`) and the hint its description (`aria-describedby`).
Clicking anywhere on the row, including the label and hint, toggles the switch.
motion: With reduced motion the thumb moves without the stretch animation and no sparks fire; the accent fill still transitions.
notes: Not a form control: it has no `name` and is not submitted with a form.
The root, the switch and its parts carry `data-state="checked"` or `data-state="unchecked"` for styling.
Changing `checked` from outside moves the thumb without the stretch and sparks; they play only for user toggles.
